intent.description: 一张静态桌面俯拍或近景平视画面:一张日常桌面占据画面主体,桌面上并列放置两张白纸(两张均为可见的、未印字的空白白纸,数量为两张,位置关系清楚可辨),纸张之间保留可被肉眼分辨的间距;桌面之外没有可见的可识别真人面孔、人物主体,纸面上没有任何印刷字、印章、表格、屏幕内容或图文痕迹;整体构图留出较充足的负空间以便后期叠加一行文字;画面呈现的是一段可观察的物理静物,不声称、也不暗示某次真实经历、某段亲历工作或某个具体场景归属。
intent.function: scene-1 establishing visual for 0-15s static shot; on-screen text is layered in post-production and is not part of this asset

constraints.preferred_visual_details: restrained low-saturation everyday lighting; plain desktop surface; generous negative space around the two sheets; no decorative props that introduce unrelated narrative; no glossy or synthetic-looking finish

queries: static overhead photograph of two blank white sheets of paper side by side on a plain wooden desk
top-down still life image of a simple desk surface with two unmarked white papers arranged next to each other
minimal flat lay photograph of two empty white A4 papers placed on a neutral everyday tabletop
